player_prompt.intro:
I na lokuta {player_id} na Connect Four.
Ndɛkɛ na: {symbol}.
Bɛnɛ na bɛnɛ a kɔndo {num_rows} na kolɔnga {num_cols}.
Lokuta tɛ na kati ndɛkɛ na kolɔnga moŋgo (0 tɛ {end_col}).
Moŋgo na kati (ndɛkɛ na ye) ndɛkɛ na minza, kɔndo, kɛ na kɛsɛ.
Na ndɛkɛ na, tɛ kolɔnga na ndɛkɛ na kɔndo.
Sɔnɔ: '[col 4]' kɛ '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: A lingbi ti bâ tableau ni pëpe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Invalid action format. Expected format: '[col x]'.

action.dropped_disk: Lokuta {player_id} a kiti ndɛkɛ na ndɛkɛ ({player_symbol}) na kolɔnga {col}.

outcome.win: Zo ti pikango ye {player_id} awara benda tongana lo tingbi ale-kozo ni!
outcome.draw: A hunzi na mbeni tiringo zo oko.
